description: Create a floorplan row. Provide EXACTLY ONE of building_id (per-building floor) or site_id (site-level / campus plan). Typically the web app calls this per page of an uploaded PDF; MCP clients rarely need to call this directly since they do not upload the PDF itself. Requires floorplans:write scope.

building_id.description: Building this floor belongs to (omit if site-scoped)

floor_order.description: Sort order within the scope (lowest first)

page_width_pt.description: Page width in PDF points (discovered client-side)

pdf_storage_path.description: Supabase Storage path to the PDF file

site_id.description: Site this plan belongs to (use for site-level / campus plans; omit if building-scoped)

name: create_floorplan
title: Create floorplan
